scope: Archived component-pilot receipts, check logs, generated proof/mutation source, and native source snapshots; production unchanged. Workload/progress/worker-failure results are separate and are not promoted by this pilot.
omissions: Compiled native/test/tool binaries, cargo targets, TLC state caches, and Lean build caches are not archived; original receipts retain their hashes. Full strict validators run against fresh target evidence before archival, not this reduced archive.
